_policy: A test listed here still RUNS in CI and its failure is reported on every build. It is tolerated only until 'expires'. The gate fails when: an unlisted test fails; a listed test PASSES (delete the entry); an entry has expired. No test is skipped, disabled or edited to get a green build. Adding an entry needs the owner's name and a root cause. Exact reviewed expected_failure_sha256 signatures are mandatory; an unreviewed or changed diagnostic blocks, including before any flaky retry.

entries.root_cause: Since commit be579b58 (2026-11-06) the /privacy/ page is deliberately noindex until the platform owner marks the privacy text as approved ('privacy.approved' switch in Platform Admin). The test still expects 'index, follow' for /privacy/. The product behaviour is intended: a legal DRAFT must not be indexed.
entries.risk_if_ignored: none for production behaviour; the test cannot detect a regression of /terms/ indexability while it fails
entries.resolution: Owner decision: (a) approve the privacy text, then the test passes as is, or (b) change the test to assert 'index, follow' for /terms/ and 'noindex' for /privacy/ while unapproved.

entries.root_cause: The '.needs-confirm' rule added by be579b58 (2026-11-06) in apps/portal/static/portal/css/public-site-v2.css uses the colour literal #f4b740 outside the :root token block, which the theme contract forbids (the public site theme must be editable from Platform Admin).
entries.risk_if_ignored: cosmetic: the 'needs confirmation' highlight ignores a custom theme
entries.resolution: Move the colour into a token in :root and reference it with var(). A CSS-only change in a separate branch; not part of the release infrastructure.

entries.root_cause: Verified on PostgreSQL 16 (2026-11-12): the exactly-once assertions of this test (6 issuances, 6 coupons) pass. The final assertion looks for 6 outbox rows with event_key 'coupon.issued' / channel 'email', but the campaign flow now writes 12 rows with event_key 'campaign.offer_percent' (email and sms), all status 'skipped' / skip_reason 'no_promotional_consent', because the test's customers have no promotional consent. The assertion is stale on BOTH the event name and the consent gate.
entries.risk_if_ignored: none for production behaviour; it is a merchant-campaign test, outside the platform payment engine
entries.resolution: Update the final assertion: expect event_key 'campaign.offer_percent'; either create the customers with promotional consent and expect 'queued', or assert 'skipped'/'no_promotional_consent'. Keep the exactly-once assertions.

entries.root_cause: The general settings page now issues 28 SQL queries; the test budget is 26. Measured on Python 3.12: the test passes on main (7d311556) and fails on the Phase-1 baseline (abab0041) and on production (6a6897b7), so the two extra queries were added by feature work between main and the baseline, before the financial/security remediation and before this release infrastructure.
entries.risk_if_ignored: two additional queries on a merchant-dashboard settings page; no correctness or security effect
entries.resolution: Find the two queries with CaptureQueriesContext (git bisect between 7d311556 and abab0041) and remove or prefetch them, or raise the budget to 28 with the reason recorded in the test.

entries.root_cause: This test is a deliberate tripwire: it fails when production code can set SubscriptionRefund.Status.FAILED while the notification 'payment.refund_failed' is still PLANNED (no producer, nothing is sent). It passes on the Phase-1 baseline (abab0041) and fails on production (6a6897b7) because the Phase-2 refund work (commit f2a8f8e5, F-06, 2026-11-10) added two places that set FAILED: apps/billing/services/refund_service.py _record_outcome and fail_refund_manually. That phase's regression runs did not include apps.notifications, so it was not noticed then.
entries.risk_if_ignored: a refund that ends as FAILED (gateway refused it, or an operator marked it failed manually) produces NO notification to the merchant or the platform owner; the refund state itself is correct and recorded
entries.resolution: Product/finance decision before the next feature release: either implement the 'payment.refund_failed' producer (then the tripwire is updated, as its message instructs) or accept in writing that a failed refund is only visible in the admin. The tripwire must not be edited to pass without that decision.

entries.root_cause: Pre-existing and documented since 2026-10-29 (docs/admin-modernization/TEST_RECONCILIATION_20261029.md). Reproduced deterministically in isolation on Python 3.12: after 'refresh_rasti_mode_demo_visuals', 3 categories of the seeded demo store still have no image. The curated manifest names 10 categories, while the demo seeder builds a larger category tree; the 3 not covered are not curated, so the assertion 'no category without image' cannot hold. The curated assets themselves are present and match SHA256SUMS (41 files). Which 3 categories exactly was not enumerated.
entries.risk_if_ignored: none for customers; this is a demo-store tooling command, not on the checkout, payment or login path
entries.resolution: Add the missing categories to the curated manifest (and assets) or restrict the assertion to the manifest categories.

entries.root_cause: Same cause as the preceding entry: the test digests the image of every seeded category and fails with ValueError ('image' attribute has no file) on a category that the curated manifest does not cover. Reproduced in isolation on Python 3.12 (about 90 s).
entries.resolution: Same fix as the preceding entry.
